preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The length of the permutation is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of good indices is between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of all N values across all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output is a permutation of length N
postconditions.description: The output is a list of integers of length N where each integer is unique and within the range [1, N].
The output permutation has exactly K indices where the value at that index is divisible by the index.

postconditions.expression: Output is any valid permutation if multiple exist
postconditions.description: If there are multiple permutations that satisfy the conditions, any one of them may be output.

postconditions.expression: Output is -1 if no permutation exists
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to construct a permutation with exactly K good indices, the output should be -1.
